THE MULTI-MILLION COPY SUNDAY TIMES BESTSELLER

An updated and expanded edition of the book that launched a global phenomenon: daily doses of practical, uplifting philosophy from the bestselling author of The Obstacle is the Way

How can we find true meaning, conquer grief or measure success? The answers to these questions and more can be found in Stoic philosophy - and The Daily Stoic is the definitive guide to bringing Stoicism into everyday life.

Selling over 3 million copies since its publication in 2016, The Daily Stoic has become a global phenomenon. Each daily dose offers powerful quotations from Stoic philosophers like Marcus Aurelius, Seneca and Epictetus, alongside historical anecdotes and thought-provoking commentary from Ryan Holiday, the voice of modern Stoicism. Read by Ryan Holiday, with a full cast, this updated anniversary edition offers new insights, updated translations and expanded ancient teachings designed to help you tackle life with serenity, self-knowledge and resilience.
